description:
Trusted device card showing device type icon, label, metadata, and
an optional revoke action. Schema-agnostic; the caller passes
already-formatted primitives so this is portable across projects.

props.name: label
props.description: Primary device label, e.g. "Chrome on macOS".

props.name: userAgent
props.description: Raw User-Agent string (displayed as secondary text in default size).

props.name: deviceType
props.description:
ua-parser-js `device.type` value ("mobile" | "tablet" | "console" |
"smarttv" | "wearable" | "embedded" | "xr" | undefined).
Empty / undefined falls back to desktop.

props.name: lastSeenAt
props.description: Last-seen timestamp; accepts Date or ISO string.

props.name: lastSeenIp
props.description: IP address of the last session.

props.name: country
props.description: Country code or name for geo display.

props.name: firstSeenAt
props.description: First-seen timestamp; accepts Date or ISO string.

props.name: isCurrent
props.description: Marks this as the current session device.

props.name: onRevoke
props.description: Callback to revoke the device. Renders a revoke button when provided.

props.name: revokePending
props.description: Disables the revoke button during pending operations.

props.name: size
props.description: "default" for the full card; "compact" for tighter surfaces.

props.name: formatDate
props.description:
Formatter for dates. Receives a Date and returns a display string.
Defaults to `toLocaleDateString()`.
